useCase: 检测图像篡改 through re-saving, quality 篡改, and spliced regions with different compression histories
mechanism: It butchers the entire DCT pixel grid to erect a frequency histogram charting compression coefficients. On an authentic, untouched camera export (Single Compression), this graph paints a perfectly smooth, bell-shaped decay curve. The exact instant an image is re-opened and re-crushed (Double Compression at clashing Quality levels), the graph's mathematics spontaneously mutates into violent, periodic 'Comb Teeth' (Peaks) and 'Death Voids' (Zeros). If this scanner detects even a fraction of this jagged comb architecture, it issues an immediate prosecution of forgery.
accuracy: 高 - 82-92% for images with detectable double compression
name: 双重JPEG压缩检测
source: Lukáš & Fridrich (2003) - Estimation of Primary Quantization Matrix in Double-Compressed JPEG Images, DFRWS
parameters: 块大小: 8x8 DCT, Quality range: 50-99, Analysis: 直方图 periodicity via DFT, Detection 阈值: 自适应
description: 检测 traces of double JPEG压缩 通过分析 DCT 系数 直方图s. Tampering often involves re-saving, creating detectable periodic 模式 in DCT domain.

references.title: Lukáš, J. & Fridrich, J. (2003). Estimation of Primary Quantization Matrix in Double-Compressed JPEG Images. DFRWS.
Bianchi, T. & Piva, A. (2012). Image Forgery Localization via Block-Grained Analysis of JPEG Artifacts. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• 对检测重新保存的JPEG非常可靠
• 可估算原始压缩质量
• 定位篡改区域
• 数学基础成熟
limitations:
• Only works on JPEG format images
• Ineffective when both compressions use same quality
• Cannot detect single-compressed AI images
• Requires sufficient image size for 统计 可靠性
